what: E45 (PR #12756) disposed of all 8 guards check_guard_liveness.py baselines as `dead`, but that script is NOT on main -- it is on PR #12742, open and mergeable_state `blocked` when read 2026-09-22T14:40Z. So BASELINE_2026_09_22 must lose all 8 entries once #12742 lands, and this is not optional: the baseline fails on rot in BOTH directions. The 4 retired guards (check_backlog_unresolve, check_open_items, check_recurrence_ledger, check_register_field_loss) will read BASELINE STALE because the scripts are deleted; the 4 kept ones (check_claim_basis, check_soak_registered, check_operator_owed, check_stated_population) will read BASELINE RECOVERED because their subjects exist or their path constants are pruned. 8 of 8 entries come out either way, which is the shrink the E45 row asked for. Whichever of #12742 and #12756 merges SECOND owns the edit; if #12742 merges second its author must drop the 8 before pushing, or main goes red on its own guard.
